Yes, that feels natural. Clicking the "design" pill right on the card immediately pulled up just the two links wearing that label, and a clear "show all" way back appeared so I'm not stuck in the filtered view. The nice part is the label doing double duty — it's not just a sticker, it's the thing I tap to say "show me everything like this." That matches how I'd instinctively reach for it: I see a label on something, I want more of the same, I click it.

So the tap-a-label-to-filter behavior, with an obvious way to clear back to everything, is what I wanted. Happy with this.
